mapper.sql: WHERE U.ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_USER' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND U.WORKER_TYPE_CODE IS NOT NULL AND U.BIRTH_YEAR IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT U.USER_ID, U.WORKER_TYPE_CODE, U.BIRTH_YEAR, NVL(A.TOTAL_ASSET_AMT, 0) AS TOTAL_ASSET_AMT, (SELECT NVL(SUM(L.BALANCE_AMT), 0) FROM USER_LOAN L WHERE L.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND L.BASE_MONTH = M.BASE_MONTH) AS TOTAL_DEBT_AMT FROM APP_USER U JOIN (SELECT USER_ID, MAX(BASE_MONTH) AS BASE_MONTH FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH GROUP BY USER_ID) M ON M.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN USER_ASSET_SNAPSHOT A ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND A.BASE_MONTH = M.BASE_MONTH
ORDER BY U.USER_ID

SELECT USER_ID, BASE_MONTH, INCOME_AMT FROM (SELECT I.USER_ID, I.BASE_MONTH, I.INCOME_AMT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY I.USER_ID ORDER BY I.BASE_MONTH DESC) AS RN FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH I JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = I.USER_ID ) WHERE RN <= 12 ORDER BY USER_ID, BASE_MONTH
